focusedDiagnosticRetry.note: Focused retry used the same playwright.studio.compat.config.ts and managed browser projects. Failures reproduced; no test was marked passing solely due to a single later pass.

remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.fact: studio-mobile-chrome: 15/16 failures are test-level 30000ms timeouts; several error-context files show click actions blocked by overlapping chrome (watchlist aside / strategy section / fieldset) — pointer interception under Pixel 7 emulation.
remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.hypothesis: Mobile layout stacking still covers actionable controls despite viewport meta width=device-width;initial-scale=1 being present in examples/nextjs-app-router/app/layout.tsx.

remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.fact: studio-mobile-safari and some studio-webkit cases fail to create drawings (Drawings (1) never appears) when tests use page.mouse.click on the canvas.
remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.hypothesis: Touch/WebKit pointer path may not register the same canvas hit-testing as desktop Chromium/Firefox; not proven as a product bug vs harness limitation without additional instrumentation.

remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.fact: Multiple WebKit/Mobile Safari tests fail solely because pageerror "ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications." is collected into an errors[] array asserted empty.
remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.hypothesis: Benign WebKit ResizeObserver noise vs real layout thrash; product code may need to filter or avoid the loop — unresolved by this QA evidence pack.

remainingViewportOrTouchIssues.fact: Touch-sized viewport operability test passed on studio-webkit and studio-mobile-safari but timed out on studio-mobile-chrome in both full suite and focused retry.
